questions.prompt: How do you list images cached on your local LXD server?
questions.explanation: lxc image list (without a remote prefix) shows all locally cached images.

questions.prompt: How do you add a human-readable alias for an image?
questions.explanation: lxc image alias add <alias> <fingerprint> creates a human-readable name for an image.

questions.prompt: Can you delete an image that's in use by a running instance?
options: No — you must stop or delete the instance first
Yes — LXD will automatically stop the instance
Yes — LXD will keep the image until the instance is deleted
Yes — but only if you use --force
questions.answer: No — you must stop or delete the instance first
questions.explanation: LXD prevents deleting images that are in use. Stop or delete the instance first.

questions.prompt: What command exports a local image to a file?
questions.explanation: lxc image export <fingerprint-or-alias> <path> saves an image to a file for backup or transfer.
